title: Case 09: The Blackout Floor
subtitle: An entire luxury apartment floor loses power for ninety seconds. When the lights return, a businessman is dead inside a biometric-locked penthouse.
loop_reset_text: Emergency lights blink off in reverse. The elevator descends upward. It is 8:51 PM again.

penthouse.name: Penthouse
penthouse.description: A biometric door stayed sealed, yet the victim died while every camera went dark.

electrical.description: A deliberate overload caused the blackout, but that does not reveal who used it.

neighbor.description: Thin walls, a balcony and a witness who heard the elevator machinery during the blackout.

elevator.description: Grease, drywall dust and a hidden service panel reveal another route into the penthouse.

timeline: 9:04 PM — Julian exits through machine room.
deduction_prompt: Who used the blackout and hidden elevator passage to enter a penthouse without opening its biometric door?
truth: Celeste caused the blackout to steal documents, but Julian exploited it. He had secretly modified the elevator service passage weeks earlier, entered through the wall, killed his partner and escaped before the power returned.
partial: You identify Julian but fail to separate his murder route from Celeste's blackout scheme.
wrong: Your theory cannot explain the sealed biometric door, elevator grease and hidden service panel. The floor goes dark again.

loop_reveals.2: Look at me. We already know Elevator Grease does not fit. This time, watch Fresh Drywall Powder before anyone knows we are suspicious.
loop_reveals.3: Something is repeating too precisely. We have Elevator Grease and Fresh Drywall Powder. Now we find the detail nobody expected us to remember.

action_beats.label: SEARCH THE SCENE WITH ASMA
action_beats.title: SCENE SEARCH
action_beats.text: Asma moves with you through the scene, checking what everyone else ignored. You compare positions, timing, and what looks slightly too deliberate.

action_beats.label: FOLLOW THE MOVEMENT YOU REMEMBER
action_beats.title: PURSUIT
action_beats.text: You move before the moment repeats. Asma follows your lead as you cut across the route you remember from the previous loop.

action_beats.label: CHASE BEFORE THEY DISAPPEAR
action_beats.title: CHASE
action_beats.text: The suspect bolts. You and Asma run the route you already learned in an earlier loop, cutting off the escape before it can repeat.

twist_hint: The obvious explanation for Case 09 is incomplete; one detail only makes sense after the loop repeats.
